history.p: Vision Transformer patch-to-CLS pipeline with precise FOUR patches. Start planar FOUR-by-FOUR colored pixel schematic subdivided into FOUR two-by-two patches, show row-major patch separation into four planar grids, flatten each and SAME shared linear projection, then four patch embedding strips. Prepend one distinct CLS strip, total FIVE position embedding inputs added -> repeated bidirectional transformer encoder with self-attention matrix and FFN residual detail -> final CLS only to classification probability output. Patch outputs may remain as four small strips beside CLS. Avoid photographic texture; conceptual pixel blocks solid. No3D. Five-position sequence alignment essential and exactly four imagepatches, no extra. Independently organized clear stage grouping.
